title: tier-2 shipped code: the character controller shape-query loop against 0x142cd4bc0
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/world.rs (move_character_controller_world), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_move_character_world entry.

The oracle runs MoveCharacterController (0x142cd4bc0) with a synthetic record whose +0x2b8 points at two 0xc0-byte shape records and whose +0x2d0 points at a sphere array. The contact id +0xa4 is -1, so the open contact event is skipped.

Cases cover a single sphere, an unchanged velocity early-out, a two-shape linked list, and the no-shape path (entry+0x24 = -1). The selected sphere bounds are written into the shape record and compared.
acknowledgedGaps: The contact event 0x142cf32d0 is open: a shape with +0xa4 != -1 returns false after its bounds. The shape types other than sphere are not exercised in this loop unit.
